title: Part Nine: Palantir and the Data Contractors

sections.brief: Palantir's founding with In-Q-Tel seed money, its NSA/Five Eyes work and the 2015 split, the Army ruling and $10bn enterprise deal, Maven; why a US contractor is not by itself a channel to Israel. Figures: time

ICE contracts (ICM, FALCON, ImmigrationOS, ELITE, the DHS BPA) with sole-source justifications; data purchases; the third-party doctrine from Miller and Smith to Carpenter and Chatrie; the unpassed Fourth Amendment Is Not For Sale Act. Figures: money; flow

The January 2024 MOD partnership, Globes' report that 8200 and Shin Bet declined Palantir, Palantir's Lavender/Gospel denial, the separate Microsoft Azure–8200 case, Storebrand's divestment, and the asymmetry of visibility. Figures: compare
